image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large, pale albino or leucistic sturgeon lying on a wet, dark surface (possibly concrete or metal). The fish's head is prominent, showing a long snout, a visible blue eye, and distinct barbels hanging near the mouth. The body extends towards the right, displaying rows of bony scutes along the lateral line. The tail is partially visible but cut off by the frame edge. There are reflections on the wet surface and some debris/wires in the foreground.

The snout tapers to a distinct point, matching the diagnostic criteria.
